coordinates: tracking pixel centres; x right, y down; use object-fit:cover crop mapping
method: Rock-only 37px ZNCC patch tracking, consecutive-frame forward-back validation; per-frame least-squares 2D affine
limitations: These local planar curves register terrain features, not a solved 3D camera. Do not extrapolate outside valid frames or across occlusion/blur. For a stone near one fiducial, prefer its measured displacement to distant/global affine motion.

proposedRouteBoard.provenance: Cyan dot centres extracted from user-provided annotated route board; composition proposals, not confirmed stone positions or one-to-one stone correspondence between panels
